Text[0]: Welcome back!
Player, did you return alone? Alphinaud and Estinien disappeared as well...
...So that is the way of it. Alas, it seems this time I'm to be one of the restless waiting.
My friend... Dare I hope the incantation was a success, and thou wert transported to the Fourth?
...You've returned temporarily to assure us, then. Very well. We shall await further word with bated breath.
Though it appears you can come and go freely, traversing the rift is never a simple affair. Pray exercise all due caution.
So this is Ethos's power... I wonder, when my ancestors invoked it to flee the Source, did they also abruptly disappear from sight?
Gods, that was a shock! Just when we thought you were gone, we noticed Alphinaud and Estinien had disappeared as well!
Ethos, was it? 'Tis as extraordinary a relic as the tales had suggested.
Glad to hear the invocation was successful. Though I presume you have matters well in hand, we shall nonetheless remain for a while, just in case you require our assistance.
I-It's really you, yes? N-Not some ghost come to haunt me for my wicked thoughts?
To think that you can travel between reflections just like that! It's amazing!
You are returned! While we had faith that all was well, without knowing for certain, we could not help being anxious.
Player, I'm glad you're safe! But, where are Alphinaud and Estinien?
You beastmasters are a fascinating lot! Your merchant friend has kindly indulged my queries, but I'm afraid my curiosity remains unsated.
Text[1]: What must it be like, dedicating one's life to the ways of the wild? Hmm...

Text[0]: If ever you're keen to visit the Crucible, speak with Lady Lauda. As for myself, I am learning to keep a tidy bestiary under Lady Loosefrox's supervision. Oh, how she scolds me...
I wish I could bear witness to your return match against Lady Lauda and Ser Guttler! One day I will do more than simply observe... <sigh>
I simply *must* share my happy news─Wiseteach J'yhuh Tia has granted me permission to forge my first pact!
Text[1]: One's first familiar is of utmost importance, so I mustn't rush into a hasty commitment... Yet how I long for my own beastfriend! Oh, what to do...

Text[0]: Lauda and Guttler, you and your Cu Sith... You've reaffirmed my faith in both beast and mankind.
Text[1]: I'm glad our paths crossed, Player. Doubtless your Cu Sith would say the same. Look after each other, eh?
Text[2]: In the meantime, perhaps I'll take a gander at the Crucible. Not against you, mind. ...Not yet, anyway.

Text[0]: While I don't expect Estinien to elude us this time, I feel much better knowing you're on the job, Player!
Oh, hello again! I was just finishing my business when I spotted this kind merchant here. Thought we might have a bit of a chat...
Though the others have left to attend to various affairs, it doesn't feel as empty here as it did before... Anyway, I'll do my best to keep everyone abreast of any developments!
The people of Treno are able to wield magicks, yes? If we can teach them how to use porxies, they would be able to treat levin sickness themselves.
I've been wondering about the possibility of bringing forth porxies via pictomancy. While potentially complicated, I believe it would be worth exploring.
Being on the moon shall allow me to more quickly sense when the Thirteenth draws closer to the Source.
Text[1]: By studying the gate at such a time, I hope to gain greater insight into the methods with which one may travel to other worlds.

Text[0]: Vast quantities of aether will surely be required to make the star whole once more. How the star might harness such energies is a question we must needs consider.
We should revisit what we know of Rejoinings. Of particular interest to me is the Fourth Umbral Calamity, which brought an end to the Allagan Empire.
I have a mind to investigate the legendary city of Mhach. There are ruins deep in the Yafaem Saltmoor, as I recall─the question is how to reach them...
All has been quiet in the sunken vault since the voidgate there was destroyed. Hopefully it remains that way...
Apparently, Radz-at-Han has the remnants of the nearby voidgate under constant mammet surveillance. Since our presence is therefore not required, we shall turn our attention to other lands.
With the recent voidsent incursion behind us, the forest has returned to its usual tranquil self. Perhaps we shall join Thancred and aid him in his endeavors.
I made sure to get my fill of brotherly love before departing the Rising Stones, so I'm not experiencing withdrawal yet! At this rate, I can fight for another ten days!
I'm somewhat curious about the dead regularly returning to life in this area, but I suppose it has nothing to do with the fissures...
Fissures no longer appear to be manifesting as frequently as before. I believe we can leave ongoing surveillance to the thaumaturges, and direct our attention elsewhere.
